sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Light Value-Added Postponement Packaging and Custom Kitting

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-5 of the Code monétaire et financier (AML/CFT obligations) and Articles L. 233-1 et seq. of the Code de commerce implementing EU Directive 2015/849 (5th AMLD) for the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign UBO Identification Documents (passport, national ID)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and French Treasury sanctions screening; adverse media and reputational checks per AMF and ACPR standards

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: infogreffe.fr / RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandatory French language and Latin script; no exceptions for transliteration or non-Latin characters
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Generic or descriptive terms (e.g., 'France', 'Paris', 'International'); reserved words implying unauthorized financial activities (banque, assurance, épargne) without ministerial approval
Names identical to existing entities or public bodies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File administrative appeal to the Président du Tribunal de Commerce within 2 months of rejection notice; subsequent judicial appeal to Cour d'Appel if denied

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices accepted provided a physical address is designated for official correspondence, tax filings, and regulatory inspections; must comply with actual address declaration requirements
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (routine incorporations <5%; targeted inspections by tax authorities or AMF possible but infrequent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal drafting, name reservation, and clearance fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff or prevailing market benchmark (1,200-2,500 EUR)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of incorporation documents and statutes
UBO beneficial ownership registration and filing fees
Apostille and consular legalization for foreign UBO documents
Registered office lease, utilities deposit, and initial setup
PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce, Livre II, Titre II, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL); R.223-1 to R.223-29; R.123-113 et seq. (immatriculation au RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), accessible electronically through Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form M0 (Cerfa n°13460*04) – 'Demande d'immatriculation au registre du commerce et des sociétés', accompanied by the signed Articles of Association and supporting certificates.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a French SARL; the capital is freely fixed in the Articles. Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked share-subscription account at a French credit institution or at the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, and the depositary certificate is required before filing Form M0. The funds are released only upon issuance of the RCS certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby adopt the Articles of Association of FR_SARL, accept the share subscriptions listed in the capital table, and approve the valuation of in-kind contributions. RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at the address stated in the Statutes, in France, and that the Manager is authorized to make all filings with the RCS. RESOLVED, that [First Name Last Name] is appointed Manager (Gérant), for an indefinite term, with full powers to bind the company, to open bank accounts, and to engage staff. RESOLVED, that the Manager is authorized to complete all formalities before Infogreffe, the tax authorities, and social security registries.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders, assisted by a notaire where required; no pre-clearance by the Registry is required before execution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts containing the corporate name, registered office in France, corporate purpose limited to light value-added logistics and kitting, share capital, share allocation, management rules, and powers of the Gérant. Have each shareholder initial each page and sign the final pages, and obtain the manager's written acceptance. If a contribution in kind exceeds EUR 30,000, engage a Commissaire aux apports to issue a valuation report.
required_dossiers: Valid national identity document or passport of each shareholder and manager
Draft of the Articles of Association
Declaration of in-kind contributions and supporting appraisal (if applicable)
Power of attorney if a shareholder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe later queries a clause, amend the Statuts by an additional shareholders' resolution and resubmit. If the registrar refuses registration, apply for judicial rectification before the President of the Commercial Court under Article R.123-92.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked share-capital deposit account and obtaining the depositary certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary 'compte de souscription' in the name of the company in formation. Transfer the cash portion of the share capital to the account. The bank verifies the identity of the founders and issues a certificate of deposit ('certificat du dépositaire des fonds') listing the amount received. This certificate is an essential annex to the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the founders
Subscribe capital distribution schedule
Bank KYC/AML information and source-of-funds declarations
Completed share subscription declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the deposit certificate is delayed, supply missing KYC documents and request written confirmation from the bank. If the bank refuses, transfer the sum to another French credit institution or to a notaire as depositary, and obtain a new certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory legal notice in a journal d'annonces légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Accredited French legal announcement journal (Journal d'annonces légales).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to an accredited JAL a legal notice containing the proposed company name, SARL form, share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, manager identity, and the RCS tribunal location. After publication, obtain the attestation of publication in the name of the company and file it with the RCS application.
required_dossiers: Extract of the draft Articles of Association
Company name, address, and capital details
Manager's full name, address, and nationality
Written confirmation that no public offering of shares was made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal journal refuses publication due to missing information, correct the draft notice and republish with the same date of reference. Where the publication certificate is delayed, request a certified copy from the journal and, if necessary, use a different accredited JAL.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the final Articles and adoption of the First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders, acting in private writing or before a notaire; the Greffe later performs legal-form control.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold a constitutive assembly or use unanimous written consent. Execute the final Articles of Association, list the subscribed shares, and formally appoint the Gérant. Sign the declaration of subscription and payment of capital. The First Board Resolution is annexed to the corporate records and used internally for banking and operational authorizations.
required_dossiers: Signed final Articles of Association
Depositary certificate of capital payment
Publication certificate of the legal announcement
Declaration of no criminal record and no legal incapacity of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a shareholder refuses to sign, obtain a court order under Article 1837 of the Civil Code to proceed or dissolve the project; otherwise, restart the incorporation with a revised capital table and obtain the missing consents in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Form M0 with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office, or Infogreffe / Guichet-entreprises online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete application electronically or physically at the Greffe. Include the signed Statuts, capital deposit certificate, legal publication certificate, manager identity documents, and Form M0. Pay the registry fee online or by bank card. Upon completeness, the Greffe examines the file and issues the RCS registration confirmation and the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Completed Form M0 (Cerfa n°13460*04)
Signed Articles of Association
Certificate of capital deposit
Legal publication certificate
Proof of identity and good standing of the manager
Power of attorney if a representative signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query or a formal notice to regularize, correct the identified shortcomings within 30 days. If the application is refused, file a summary application before the President of the Commercial Court to order the entry; in case of persistent rejection, file a new M0 after curing the legal defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with INSEE, DGFiP, and URSSAF, and obtention of the Kbis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE; Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); Union de Recouvrement des Cotisations de Sécurité Sociale et d'Allocations Familiales (URSSAF).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the formal RCS registration, confirm the automatic allocation of the SIREN and SIRET numbers. Register for French VAT and employer obligations if the company makes intra-community acquisitions or plans to hire staff. If employees are engaged, open the DSN (Déclaration Sociale Nominative) with URSSAF and finalize the workplace occupational risk assessment.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract or RCS registration receipt
SIREN/SIRET automatic assignment notice
VAT registration form if applicable
URSSAF employer registration request
DUERP (Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels) for the first workplace
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIRET or tax identifiers are not received within the statutory period, contact the relevant INSEE regional office and the SIE (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) to correct the data. For URSSAF delays, file the employer registration manually with the competent URSSAF office and retain an acknowledgment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No specific industrial licensing board for light kitting and fulfillment assembly. Relevant oversight authorities are the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for ICPE compliance and the Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) for workplace health and safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No mandatory operating license under French law for warehousing and kitting activities below the ICPE thresholds; optional voluntary certifications (ISO 9001, security clearance) may be adopted for commercial purposes.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique, direction régionale DREAL, in coordination with the local police of water and classified installations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for a typical small-scale fulfillment operation with covered storage under 1,250 m². If the covered storage surface is between 1,250 m² and 5,000 m², a simple déclaration under rubrique 1510 is required; a full EIA report may become mandatory only for large logistics centers exceeding the authorization thresholds under the Code de l'environnement.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: discharge to the public sewer must comply with the local sanitation authority's limits, generally pH 6.5–8.5, COD < 125 mg/L, BOD5 < 30 mg/L, and TSS < 35 mg/L. Stormwater from outside storage areas must be free of hydrocarbons. VOC emissions from adhesives or cleaning products shall stay below the French COV thresholds (typically 20 g/L for water-based products). Packaging waste must be separated and recycled under the AGEC producer-responsibility schemes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For premises up to 1,250 m² not open to the public, no fire-safety authorization is required, but the company must still install detection, emergency exits, extinguishers, and an evacuation plan and may request the local SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours) for advice. A structural load inspection is recommended for high-bay racking and mezzanines. The employment site must have a DUERP completed and displayed labor-code notices; before commencing operations, the DREETS may require a declaration of opening if employees are hired.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate an SARL via the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), which generates a SIREN/SIRET through INSEE. 2) The DGFiP automatically assigns a French VAT number (numéro d'identification à la TVA intracommunautaire) to the registered entity. 3) For a foreign entity with no French establishment, the procedure is to file form 1542-SD (Demande d'inscription au fichier des organismes étrangers) with the competent SIE (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) or through the Guichet Unique, appointing a tax representative if required for VAT purposes. 4) A SIRET is issued for each place of activity, and the entity must file an initial VAT return (form 1142 or 1143) depending on closing. 5) The VAT number is verified by the French government's intra-community VIES validator.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not operate a universal check-the-box regime. An SARL is by default chargeable to corporation tax (impôt sur les sociétés). Statutory elections allow pass-through taxation in narrowly defined cases: (i) family-owned SARL (SARL de famille); and (ii) a small commercial/artisanal/industrial/professional SARL employing fewer than 50 employees and with turnover not exceeding EUR 10 million may opt for income tax for up to five years (article 239 bis AA CGI). Additionally, foreign entity classification for hybrid mismatch purposes follows article 165 bis CGI and the ATAD provisions, and an SARL may be recharacterized for French tax purposes if its legal form is equivalent to a transparent entity under the criteria of legal equivalence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée - TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA: EUR 91,900 for goods-supplying activities and EUR 36,800 for services-providing activities (annual turnover); above these thresholds, registration is mandatory for French-established businesses. Non-established foreign suppliers have no exemption threshold and must register if any taxable supply is deemed to take place in France.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing becomes mandatory for all established taxable persons for B2B transactions from 1 September 2026 (large and mid-size enterprises) and 1 September 2027 (small and micro enterprises). Invoices must be transmitted through a certified PDP (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) or the public portal (Portail Public de Facturation), using the Factur-X hybrid format. Transaction data are transmitted to DGFiP for automated fiscal clearance and pre-filling of VAT returns; there is no per-invoice stamping or real-time clearance in the sense of a continuous control system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT at 0% applies to supplies of goods physically sent or transported outside the EU by the seller or a third party for account of the seller, provided the exporter retains evidence of export within 90 days from the chargeable event (or, under recent flexibility, within the time limit to file the VAT return). The goods must leave the EU before the end of the third month following the transfer of power to dispose. For services to non-EU business customers, the place of supply is outside France, thus outside French VAT; certain ancillary services linked to exported goods qualify for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU - Document Administratif Unique or DEX)
Bill of Lading (or equivalent transport document: Air Waybill, CMR)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of export payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration (DGFiP) may challenge the 0% application if the export proof is incomplete, missing, or contradictory, and may reassess VAT at 20% (TVA au taux normal), together with the late payment interest ('intérêts de retard' of 0.2% per month) and penalties: 40% for deliberate infringement (manquement délibéré), 80% for fraudulent behavior or if the taxpayer has not submitted a return within 30 days after a formal notice. In cases of export fraud, criminal sanctions may apply to company representatives, and the tax administration may also claim restitution of deducted input VAT. Retrospective clawback is permitted within the statutory re-assessment period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: European Central Bank for monetary policy and euro-system oversight; Banque de France for national central-bank functions, payment-system oversight, balance-of-payments and statistical reporting; Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution for prudential supervision of credit institutions and certain payment institutions; Autorité des Marchés Financiers for financial-market conduct and investment-services regulation; Direction Générale du Trésor for national financial-policy administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area jurisdiction with full current-account and capital-account convertibility, subject to European Union financial-sanctions controls, anti-money-laundering requirements, tax rules, cash-reporting rules, payment-services regulation and limited statistical reporting. The euro is freely transferable for ordinary operating payments, imports, exports, dividends, interest, royalties, intercompany settlements and loan repayments. A French SARL may generally hold and use foreign-currency accounts and remit distributable profits to non-resident shareholders without a general exchange-control approval. Profit distributions require finalized annual accounts, an available distributable profit or lawful reserve, shareholder approval, satisfaction of corporate-law restrictions, withholding-tax analysis, beneficial-owner verification and completion of any applicable treaty or European Union directive documentation. Cross-border capital contributions, shareholder loans and treasury transfers may be subject to bank source-of-funds review, related-party documentation, transfer-pricing requirements, thin-capitalization or interest-limitation rules, and tax reporting. Payments involving sanctioned persons, sanctioned jurisdictions, prohibited sectors or unusual payment chains may be blocked or escalated.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio and no general deadline requiring a French exporter to convert foreign-currency export receipts into euros. Export proceeds may normally remain in the invoiced currency or be converted at the company’s discretion through an authorized payment-service provider or credit institution. The company must retain commercial invoices, transport and customs evidence, contracts, remittance records and accounting support. Banks may request trade documents and transaction-purpose information under AML, sanctions, fraud-prevention and regulatory-reporting controls. Cash or cash-equivalent movements of EUR 10,000 or more into or out of the European Union require the applicable customs declaration; this rule does not generally apply to ordinary bank transfers, which remain subject to bank monitoring and reporting obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Deposit Account for incorporation or capital increase, followed by EUR Operational Account and Foreign-Currency Account where required

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant regional Crédit Agricole caisse
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Deposit Account for incorporation or capital increase, followed by EUR Operational Account and Foreign-Currency Account where required
Capital Deposit Account for incorporation or capital increase, followed by EUR Operational Account and Foreign-Currency Account where required

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BPCE S.A. and the relevant Banque Populaire or Caisse d’Epargne network entity
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Deposit Account for incorporation or capital increase, followed by EUR Operational Account and Foreign-Currency Account where required

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to High for routine EUR collections, SEPA payments, card expenditure, multi-currency balances and treasury administration, subject to the provider’s licensing perimeter, country risk policy, safeguarding model and account-closure rules. Airwallex and comparable electronic-money institutions or payment institutions may provide payment accounts or safeguarded funds but do not necessarily provide a French bank deposit account, French IBAN, deposit-guarantee coverage or capital-deposit services acceptable for every incorporation workflow. Offshore digital EMIs without authorization under the EU Payment Services Directive framework, passporting rights, or an equivalent legally recognized authorization should not be used for regulated payment services to or from the French SARL. Fintech accounts should supplement, rather than replace, a primary French bank account for payroll, taxes, customs, statutory payments, capital deposits and business continuity. The company must verify the provider’s legal entity, authorization register entry, safeguarding arrangements, terms for frozen funds, permitted countries, beneficial-owner requirements and data-access procedures.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal requirement that all directors physically appear at a bank branch to open a corporate account. Remote onboarding may be permitted following reliable identification, video verification, qualified or advanced electronic-signature procedures, beneficial-owner verification and satisfactory risk assessment. A bank may nevertheless require a branch meeting, notarized or apostilled documents, certified translations, original documents, a French-resident signatory, a live compliance interview or an in-person meeting for a newly incorporated SARL, non-resident ownership, complex shareholder chains, high-risk jurisdictions, unusual business models or anticipated high transaction volumes. The capital-deposit bank account is institution-specific and should be arranged before incorporation completion; after registration and delivery of the Kbis extract, the bank normally converts or releases the account into the operating account in accordance with its procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership, nominee ownership, bearer-like arrangements, ownership through opaque entities or inability to provide the ultimate natural-person ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current articles of association; Kbis extract; shareholder register; ownership chart to each natural-person beneficial owner; passports or national identity documents; proof of residential address; director appointment evidence; UBO declaration filed with the competent French registry where applicable; certificates of incorporation and registers for corporate shareholders; and a signed ownership-and-control certification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder or director, foreign management team or mismatch between the company’s French registration and its actual operating location.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan; French registered-office agreement; warehouse or fulfillment contract; customer and supplier agreements; management-responsibility matrix; tax-registration evidence; director and shareholder identification; explanation of the French economic rationale; expected countries and currencies; and a written description of staffing, logistics and decision-making in France.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected cross-border payment volume or transaction geography inconsistent with a low-risk fulfillment, kitting and packaging profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month cash-flow forecast; transaction-volume and average-ticket schedule; expected counterparties and countries; sample invoices; logistics and customs records; service agreements; payment-flow diagram; source-and-use-of-funds statement; and controls for sanctions screening, invoice verification and segregation of customer funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound shareholder funding, shareholder loans or third-party funding with unclear source of wealth, source of funds or economic purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed capital-increase or shareholder-loan agreement; corporate approvals; lender or investor ownership documents; audited or management accounts; bank statements; evidence of accumulated funds; tax returns or financial statements where appropriate; remitter-to-beneficial-owner explanation; and a reconciliation showing the intended accounting treatment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction, sanctioned-country exposure, sanctioned-party match, politically exposed person status or adverse media involving a shareholder, director, customer or supplier.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full counterparty due-diligence file; passport and date-of-birth confirmation; sanctions-screening results; PEP declaration; adverse-media analysis; contractual end-use and end-customer information; licensing or authorization evidence; enhanced monitoring plan; and a documented legal assessment confirming that the proposed transactions are permissible.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inadequate evidence for goods movement, customs status, VAT treatment or the commercial substance of fulfillment and kitting services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customer contracts; purchase orders; commercial invoices; packing lists; transport documents; warehouse records; customs declarations; VAT numbers; inventory ownership matrix; evidence distinguishing service revenue from sale of goods; and documented procedures for returns, damaged goods and customer-owned inventory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, third-party payment accounts, cash-intensive settlement, unexplained payment intermediaries or frequent rapid pass-through transfers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal treasury policy; approved bank-account list; payment-approval matrix; segregation-of-duties controls; explanation of each intermediary; service-provider agreements; reconciliation reports; prohibition of personal accounts; cash limits; and evidence of automated sanctions and beneficiary screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete corporate records, inconsistent legal names, expired identification documents, unverified registered office or failure to provide French tax and corporate filings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent Kbis extract; current articles; registry filings; valid identification documents; registered-office proof; tax-registration evidence; board or shareholder resolutions; powers of attorney; certified translations where requested; and a document-control schedule showing issue and expiry dates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route capital contributions through an account held in the exact legal name of the SARL or through the designated capital-deposit account of the incorporating bank. Use SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR transfers from participating institutions and SWIFT cross-border transfer for non-SEPA currencies or jurisdictions. The remitter name, beneficiary name, legal entity identifier where available, and payment narrative should clearly identify the capital contribution, capital increase or shareholder loan. For a capital contribution, provide the subscription form, shareholder or extraordinary shareholder resolution, draft or executed capital-increase documentation, source-of-funds evidence, ownership chart and bank remittance confirmation. For a shareholder loan, provide the executed loan agreement, interest and maturity terms, transfer-pricing support, withholding-tax analysis and corporate approvals. Do not route funds through personal accounts or unrelated third parties. Reconcile the incoming amount to the accounting entry and retain the payment message, bank advice and supporting corporate documents. French banks generally do not use a universal statutory FX purpose-code system equivalent to certain exchange-controlled jurisdictions; they may nevertheless require internal payment-purpose classifications, economic-purpose descriptions, counterparty data and regulatory or statistical information.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible EUR suppliers and payroll-related beneficiaries, subject to scheme limits and bank controls. Use SWIFT customer credit transfer, commonly evidenced by an MT103 or its ISO 20022 equivalent, for non-SEPA payments and foreign currencies. Use commercial documentary letters of credit, standby letters of credit, documentary collections, bank guarantees or open-account payments according to counterparty risk, Incoterms, customs obligations and fraud controls. A commercial LC should specify issuing and advising banks, applicant and beneficiary, amount and currency, expiry, shipment terms, required documents, presentation period, partial-shipment rules and discrepancy handling. Screen all beneficiaries, banks, vessels and jurisdictions against applicable European Union, French and United Nations sanctions. Maintain purchase orders, invoices, transport documents, customs records, proof of delivery and three-way-match evidence. The bank may delay, reject or report a payment where sanctions, AML, fraud, tax-evasion or trade-based-money-laundering concerns arise.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with an authorized bank or investment firm, documented against forecast or committed commercial exposures and subject to counterparty credit limits, confirmations, valuation and accounting controls.

Non-deliverable forwards where offered by an authorized counterparty and legally appropriate for the relevant currency, with cash settlement, documented underlying exposure, sanctions review, appropriateness assessment and EMIR-related reporting or risk-mitigation analysis.

Currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for identified funding or currency exposures, subject to ISDA or equivalent master documentation, collateral terms, counterparty limits, valuation, close-out and EMIR compliance.
Spot foreign-exchange transactions for operational conversion of receipts and payments through an authorized credit institution or payment provider.

Currency options, collars and option-based hedges only after documented approval of premium, liquidity, valuation, suitability, accounting treatment, maximum-loss exposure and counterparty terms; speculative trading unrelated to the SARL’s commercial exposures should be prohibited.

All derivatives should be supported by a board-approved treasury policy, exposure register, hedge-designation analysis where hedge accounting is intended, confirmation controls, independent valuation, collateral monitoring and periodic effectiveness review.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels) comprising balance sheet, profit-and-loss account, and notes to the financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce competent for the SARL's registered office (via the Guichet Unique)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end; the shareholders' meeting approving the accounts must be held by that date and the deposit must be made immediately after the meeting (e.g., by 30 June for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late-filing registry surcharge (about EUR 15, i.e., about USD 16) plus a possible court order under Article L. 232-25 of the Commercial Code compelling the deposit; persistent default may lead to administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RNE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and financial annex (liasse fiscale, forms 2050-2059)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months of the financial year-end; for a fiscal year closing on 31 December, e-filing is due no later than 3 May of the following year (or the next business day if 3 May is a weekend).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the net tax payable, plus 0.25% monthly late-payment interest (intérêt de retard); non-filing after a 30-day formal reminder exposes the company to ex officio assessment by the tax administration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business tax declaration (déclaration de cotisation foncière des entreprises, CFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP - Public Finance Centre for business taxes (service des impôts des entreprises) of the place of establishment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 December for liability incurred on 1 January of the same year; payment is due on the same day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late or incomplete declaration triggers a penalty of 10% (or, under repeated failure, 20%) of the assessed tax, plus late-payment interest at 0.25% per month; the tax administration may also apply a direct assessment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a French SARL, appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when at the financial year-end at least two of the following thresholds are exceeded: balance sheet total above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover (excl. VAT) above EUR 8,000,000; average of at least 50 employees during the year. Below these thresholds, an audit is optional but may be required in group contexts or upon the request of members representing at least 10% of capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) in conformity with the Règlement ANC 2016-01 and 2018-01; for consolidated financial statements, IFRS as adopted by the EU is mandatory for listed groups but not required for the statutory individual accounts of an unlisted SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require a stand-alone annual UBO filing when there is no change. The SARL must file the initial beneficial-owner declaration at incorporation and must update it within 30 days of any change (by electronic filing to the Greffe/RNE via Guichet Unique). At each annual general meeting the gérant must verify the accuracy of the UBO register and file a revised declaration if a change occurred. Failure to update within the 30-day window carries criminal penalties for the gérant and the legal entity.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des titres de capital)
Register of Decisions of Shareholders’ Meetings (registre des délibérations et procès-verbaux d’assemblées)
Register of Beneficial Owners (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - 800 per annum (EUR 230 - 740) depending on location and corporate-agent scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 when the statutory thresholds are not met; USD 5,500 - 16,000 when a voluntary or mandatory statutory audit is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for qualifying SMEs (annual turnover below €10 million) applied to the first €42,500 of profit; 3.3% social surcharge on corporate income tax exceeding €763,000; no sector-specific exemption for fulfillment or kitting activities.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carryforward; annual deduction cap of €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding €1,000,000)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (Cerfa n° 11563) as the main corporate income tax return, with annexes 2058-A through 2058-S; mandatory e-filing through the French tax authority's EFI/GEDI portal (www.impots.gouv.fr) via EDI or EDI-ECF.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months following the end of the fiscal year; for companies closing accounts on 31 December, the deadline is 30 April of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter legal name, SIREN, registered address, legal form (SARL), fiscal year dates, and tax office of residence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No distinct non-resident field for the entity itself; if the SARL is owned by non-residents, identify the entity as a French domestic taxable company; UBO details are disclosed separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State net accounting profit or loss as per the statutory annual accounts under French GAAP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the SARL's own French GAAP result; non-resident ownership does not affect this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductible items and subtract non-taxable income to reconcile accounting and fiscal results.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose any transfer pricing adjustments with non-resident affiliates; failure to do so exposes the company to Article 57 CGI involuntary adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determine the fiscal result before application of carried forward deficits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SARL is taxed on its worldwide income as a French resident; no non-resident-specific allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report the amount of prior-year losses deducted this year, limited to €1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable amount above €1,000,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses belong to the French entity and remain usable even if ownership is non-resident; in cross-border restructuring, treaty and domestic anti-abuse rules may restrict transfer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute final taxable profit and applied rate: 25% standard, or 15% reduced rate for first €42,500 of SME profit; add 3.3% social surcharge if tax exceeds €763,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entity-level tax is unaffected by shareholder residence; withholding tax on distributions is applied or claimed by the shareholder.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% penalty on assessed tax plus monthly 0.2% surcharge (total max 40%); penalty reduced to 5% if the return is filed within 30 days of a formal demand. Late payment: interest at 0.2% per month. Willful concealment: 80% penalty, plus up to 5 years' imprisonment and €500,000 fine.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To reduce or eliminate dividend withholding, the non-resident shareholder must be the beneficial owner and submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) to the French paying entity before distribution. For EU/EEA parent companies holding at least 10% capital for 24 months, the Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption applies via attestation on Form 1182. If documentation is not provided, the statutory 25% withholding applies, and a formal refund claim can be submitted within two years per LPF Art. R.196-1.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic 33.33% withholding (reduced to 25% under certain treaties and 0% under EU Interest-Royalties Directive for an associated company with ≥25% holding). Interest: no formal domestic withholding on ordinary written, arm's-length interest paid to a foreign beneficial owner, except a 30% tax on interest paid to non-cooperative jurisdictions; 0% for qualifying EU associated companies under the same Directive.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File are mandatory where the French entity reports annual net turnover above €50 million or total balance-sheet assets above €400 million; Country-by-Country reporting and Master File apply where the multinational group reaches consolidated revenue of €750 million or more.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France has no standalone Economic Substance Regulation applicable to domestic ordinary trading entities. The French general anti-abuse rule (Article L.64 LPF) and the OECD Principal Purpose Test embedded in tax treaties impose a genuine substance requirement. A fulfillment/kitting SARL with physical premises, storage equipment, and 3PL personnel meets the required operational substance threshold.
